articles.title: SpaceX targets June 11 IPO pricing, picks Nasdaq for historic market debut
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s rocket and satellite company has accelerated plans for its blockbuster public offering, with trading expected to begin as early as June 12 after a faster-than-expected SEC review.

articles.title: Lombard joins LayerZero exodus as $4 billion in assets switch to Chainlink's bridge
articles.snippet: The shift comes after the Kelp DAO exploit drained $292 million from its LayerZero-powered bridge, increasing concerns over the security of cross-chain infrastructure.

articles.title: Iran war shows markets no longer sleep
articles.snippet: The latest conflict involving Iran has produced an unexpected proving ground for financial infrastructure, and an unlikely winner has emerged, argues Huang.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives up Clarity Act gains as macro rout wipes out leveraged crypto bulls
articles.snippet: Stocks, gold and crypto slid on Friday while crude oil topped $100 and traders repriced Fed expectations for rate hikes.

articles.title: THORChain confirms $10M exploit, rolls out recovery portal for affected users
articles.snippet: THORChain has launched a recovery portal following a $10 million exploit, allowing affected users across four chains to revoke malicious approvals and claim refunds.
